Subject: Steering committee scheduling and next steps

Hi Emma / Carlos —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery + proposed next steps so we keep momentum toward a decision:  

What we heard (summary):
- Primary use: patient summary generation and internal clinical search (low-batch, low-latency at peak times).
- Key decision criteria: latency under 350ms p95 for 1k concurrent users, predictable monthly spend, and SOC2 / DPA for PHI-adjacent data.
- Timeline: exec steering committee & procurement signoff targeted early March (you mentioned a 2–3 week procurement window).

Proposed next steps:
1) Schedule a 45-minute steering committee with Carlos (exec sponsor), tech leads, and procurement/legal. Redwood will present SLOs, deployment options (hosted vs. private), and a short risk/controls summary.
2) Share executive one-pager + risk summary for the committee (attached).
3) Confirm procurement path and expected PO/contract milestones.

Suggested times (PT):
- Tue 2026-03-03 2:00–2:45pm
- Wed 2026-03-04 10:00–10:45am
- Thu 2026-03-05 3:00–3:45pm

Who's joining from Redwood: Aditya Rao (solutions — runtime/latency), Dev Patel (customer success — onboarding/SLA), and myself (AE / commercial & next steps).  

Attachments: Post-Call_Recap_ACR-Redwood.pdf (this mail) — contains detailed meeting notes and a draft agenda.

Emma/Carlos — can you confirm which time works and who from your side (legal/procurement) you'd like present? If you prefer, we can also run a short 20-min pre-brief with your security lead prior to the steering committee.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183
